reviews.title: Thankful and hopeful
reviews.text: I’m so thankful for a free app to easily track my macros. I have been struggling with secondary infertility and realized that the biggest difference since giving birth to my daughter in 2022 is 10 pounds. Having spent thousands of dollars on different supplements and fertility tools, I couldn’t fathom spending more money on an app that may not help. I searched the internet for a free food tracking app and saw this one recommended on Reddit. Yesterday was my first time using the app and I felt so empowered and pleased with how simple it is to use. I look forward to continuing towards my goal and for the first time in a long time, I’m feeling hopeful.

reviews.title: This app is great!
reviews.text: It’s a free app that has a lot of great features! One such feature is the ability to add a meal via a description that an AI uses to estimate calories and macros! The app also has a barcode scanner and other ways to log calories. Another awesome feature is the graph the app provides so you can see either you weight loss or gain progress in real time. I struggle a lot with seeing progress and the graph really helps!

reviews.title: Great. Simple.  + one enhancement idea
reviews.text:
The app is exactly what it advertises to be.  Free, no ads, easy to use and set up, allows barcode scanning.

Enhancement idea for the developers: either
1) integrate with Apple Health (sending and receiving data) so I don’t have to double enter my weight, calories burned, etc.  
2) allow exporting of historical data so I can import to Apple Health myself.

reviews.title: Good, but some critical usability issues
reviews.text: I’ve had issues with AI giving me vastly different estimates for the same prompts. Makes no sense. More critically to me though is the weight tracker issue. One me phone, the save button often shows up far in the top right of the screen after inputting my weight. Its location is behind my battery icon and it is almost impossible to register that I tap on it. I end up doing a rapid fire of taps. After about 5-10 seconds it finally collapses the keyboard and allows me to click on the save button, which has moved further down the screen.

reviews.title: Best by far
reviews.text: This has been my favorite calorie app by far, I just saw it was updated which reminded me to make this review. I used this app during a 6 week challenge and I was able to track my intake so easily, I dropped 3% body fat within that challenge. I’m glad it’s still getting updates, by far my favorite app for counting calories. This is also my first ever written review, so it definitely is telling on how well done the app is. (to me at least).

reviews.title: Great for someone just starting out
reviews.text:
This is a great tracker for someone just starting out and isn’t looking to get too deep in the weeds.

No ads, ease of use.

I like the added weight tracking as well.

The set up was simple too, just asking for weight and goals and it does the rest.

My one complaint would be that once you’ve set up you can’t redo it. The initial setup asks for your weight and gives calorie goals ranging from simple to extreme.

But once you’ve hit your goal weight you have to do some guess work yourself when putting in calorie goals, there’s no option to redo the set up.
